title: N-AALP Signature (COSE Algorithm) Registry
description: Schema for the JSON representation of vectors/registry/signatures.csv: an array of row objects, one per registered or reserved object-signature algorithm. The CI check converts the CSV to this array (header row -> object keys) and coerces the declared-integer columns (cose_alg, nist_level) from their CSV string form to int before validating. cose_alg is the COSE algorithm identifier (a signed integer) for a 'registered' algorithm, or empty for a 'reserved' one that carries no code point yet (e.g. SLH-DSA). nist_level is the NIST post-quantum security category: 0 for the classical Ed25519 hybrid leg, otherwise 1-5. Wrong types, missing columns, out-of-set role/status, out-of-range nist_level, and an empty reference are caught here; DUPLICATE algorithm names are caught by the companion scripts/validate_registries.py.

name.description: Signature algorithm name; MUST be non-empty (e.g. ML-DSA-65).

cose_alg.description: COSE algorithm identifier (signed integer) for a registered algorithm; empty for a reserved algorithm that carries no code point.

nist_level.description: NIST PQ security category: 0 for the classical hybrid leg, 1-5 otherwise.

role.description: Role of the algorithm in the object-signing profile.

status.description: 'registered' (has a code point and vectors) or 'reserved' (name held, no code point yet).

reference.description: Normative reference (e.g. RFC9964, RFC9864, FIPS205); MUST be non-empty.
